verdict.rationale: cubic has its own built-in AI assistant to which users can hand off tasks. You can tag @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can also click 'Fix with cubic' or turn on auto-fix so cubic generates fixes and pushes them to the PR branch, and an AI chat answers questions while you read a PR. missing for 10: delegation documented beyond review, fix and Q&A tasks; current (non-archive) documentation of the in-app AI chat; independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly, or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation.
cubic can automatically fix issues in the background. When the AI spots a problem, you can click the **Fix with cubic** button
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
Request a targeted fix with one click, or turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.
AI chat answers questions about a pull request while you read it. It reads the PR and the rest of your codebase.
